intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Powerpole modular housings and two-pole SB housings are different connection systems. A family name alone does not establish mating fit, current rating or polarity. Contact part number, cable cross-section, temperature rise, assembly method and the manufacturer's series-specific documentation all matter.
copy.zh: 模块化 Powerpole 与双极 SB 属于不同连接体系。仅凭系列名称不能认定可对插、电流额定值或极性。触点料号、线径、温升、装配方法及制造商对应系列资料都必须纳入审核。

copy.en: Supply the manufacturer and complete connector series or part number, mating-side photograph and contact view, circuit and polarity drawing, continuous and peak load, voltage, wire size and cable length, opposite-end interface, installation environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Identify auxiliary contacts or battery-monitoring circuits separately.
copy.zh: 请提供制造商及完整接口系列／料号、对插侧照片与触点视图、回路和极性图、连续与峰值负载、电压、线径与长度、另一端接口、安装环境、数量和接收标准。辅助触点或电池监测回路须单独标明。

copy.en: The approved inputs become a controlled connector-and-contact BOM, cable drawing, polarity map, assembly instructions and first-article checklist. The inspection scope can cover wire identity, crimp geometry, contact retention, housing keying, cable length and agreed electrical checks. Continuity alone cannot prove rated-load temperature, charging-system compatibility or equipment safety.
copy.zh: 批准资料将转成受控的壳体与触点物料表、线缆图、极性表、装配指引和首件核对清单。检验范围可包括线号、压接几何、触点保持、壳体防错、长度及约定电气项目。导通合格不能单独证明额定负载温升、充电系统兼容或设备安全。

copy.en: Identify the mating part number and termination method before confirming the assembly drawing.
copy.zh: 确认对插件料号和端接方式，再确定组件图纸。

copy.en: Compare the sample with the approved pin map, dimensions and material list.
copy.zh: 按确认的针脚对应、尺寸和材料清单审核样品。

copy.en: Retain the approved part list and inspection results for repeat production.
copy.zh: 保留确认物料清单与检验结果，作为重复生产依据。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
